issue.title: pan close still deletes state.json/sessions.json — close-out.ts step 5 never moved to pruneAgentStateDir (PAN-3950 AC-1 unmet)
acceptanceCriteria: Given state.json, sessions.json and activity.jsonl under getOverdeckHome()/agents/agent-pan-100/, when closeOut({ issueId: 'PAN-100' }) succeeds, then all three files still exist and no .retained-transcripts marker exists
After closeOut, state.json.status reads 'stopped' (teardown's persistIssueAgentsStopped still runs) and result.steps contains no step named close-out:prune-agent-rows

grep -n "pruneStoppedAgentsForIssue\|cloister/agent-gc\|prune-agent-rows" src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts prints nothing, and closeOut still emits close-out:mark-pipeline-terminal followed by close-out:ack-parked-residue
The new test fails on unfixed workflows.ts (state.json missing) and passes after the block is deleted — the implementation checkpoint result is stated in the commit body
grep -rn pruneStoppedAgentsForIssue src tests --include=*.ts prints nothing
tests/unit/lib/cloister/agent-gc.test.ts passes and still contains the 'excludes already-retired agents before terminal issue resolution' test and the PAN-3513 terminality tests
pruneTerminalStoppedAgents stays exported: `pan admin db gc-agents --help` prints the command, and `npm run typecheck` exits 0
grep -n "removeAgentStateDir\|executeCloseOut" src/lib/close-out.ts prints nothing and src/lib/__tests__/close-out.test.ts no longer exists

src/lib/close-out.ts still exports isBranchMerged with unchanged behaviour: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/reap-issue-residue.test.ts passes and pan workspace list --stale --help still prints
`npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both exit 0, and lint prints no unused-import finding for src/lib/close-out.ts
git diff --stat main...HEAD -- src shows more deletions than insertions for the branch
`grep -n "close-out:prune-agent-rows" docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md` prints exactly one line, inside the close-out paragraph, stating that the ceremony runs no agent-row garbage collection of its own
